minutes.headline: Select Board and Planning Board appointed Matthew Allison to the planning vacancy 5-3 after a heated joint session.
minutes.summary: The Select Board met jointly with the Planning Board and filled a planning vacancy by a 5-3 vote after sharp disagreement over whether the choice was political. The board also ratified police reserve officers and a new sergeant, approved a utility pole petition, authorized the chair to sign the MSBA funding agreement, and appointed members to the Council on Aging and Personnel Committee. The August 5th meeting becomes a gas pipeline seminar at the high school.

what_happened.line: The Select Board and Planning Board, meeting jointly, filled the planning board vacancy with Matthew Allison by a 5-3 vote, to serve until the next election.
The board authorized the chair to sign the MSBA funding agreement for the school building project when it becomes available.
The board ratified three reserve police officers and a new police sergeant, and approved moving one utility pole and placing a new one on Wetherby Street.
The board appointed four members to the Council on Aging and two to the Personnel Committee; remaining candidates will be interviewed August 12th.
The August 5th meeting becomes the gas pipeline seminar at the high school with no board business; a financing update was postponed to August 12th.

why_it_matters: The MSBA agreement and the short-term borrowing on already authorized school project funds bear on the town's school building costs, which are paid mostly from taxes.
The planning board vacancy was filled until the next election, so the seat will be on a ballot residents vote on.
